purpose: Portable review-only MOEMOA design history and V1–V8 fictional prototypes; not production implementation or deployment.

origin.description: Selected files imported from the task's original Codex visualizations review folder. Original files remain untouched.
origin.sourceGitCommitNote: The review folder was not a Git checkout; no source commit is asserted.

inventory.manifestScope: The files array covers 169 imported files only. README.md and this generated manifest are companion repository files, not original review-folder imports.

constraints: Only local review prototypes, fictional fixture data, generated artwork, design-history screenshots and verification/provenance documents are included.

logo-before.png is the user's supplied brand reference, not generated art or a private photograph. Film logo studies were generated from that reference; no final font, SVG or trademark clearance is asserted.
Prototype memories, titles and boards are fictional test data. This import does not upload real user photographs, credentials, account state, environment files or production records.
Raw third-party Are.na reference screenshots are excluded. Source URLs and measured design observations remain in interaction-v5-references.json.
Prototype runtime images are local; existing remote fonts and three legacy wrapper scripts remain external dependencies and were not downloaded.
These historical snapshots include earlier design approaches. V8 is the latest review candidate; older hero-containing snapshots are historical evidence, not permission to reintroduce hero sections.
No database migration, production source replacement, public UGC enablement, commit, push or deployment is performed by this import.
sha256 and bytes describe the imported file after any explicitly listed portability repair. sourceSha256 and sourceBytes preserve the original review-folder file identity.

assetProvenance.use: Fictional title covers and memory scenes only; no anime screenshots or third-party fanart copied as application art.
User-requested brand development; selected direction is film logo option 2, not final vector or rights clearance.
Original brand sheet supplied for this design-history task; preserved as reference.
Visual proofs of the fictional prototypes and locally rendered design guides. Before screenshots compare the named prototype version, not necessarily the original service.

externalRuntimeDependencies.purpose: Existing Pretendard font stylesheet; exact font appearance needs network access.
Earlier design studies retain existing externally served fonts.

historicalPathMetadata.note: Historical local output and generated-asset paths are provenance, not runtime dependencies. Portable assets use filenames in this folder.
Historical generated-image source path is provenance, not a runtime dependency.
Historical repository and agent-browser skill paths record the validation environment, not runtime dependencies.

validation.import: All 169 files were first copied byte-for-byte and compared to source SHA-256. The legacy missing-logo gallery alone was then explicitly repaired.
validation.localDependencyClosure: All retained runtime assets, HTML/CSS/JS dependencies, linked comparison images and report-referenced screenshots are included, except four unavailable old-logo source images now represented by honest noninteractive placeholders.
validation.sourcePngMetadata: All 170 source PNGs were inspected for eXIf/iTXt/zTXt/tEXt chunks; none were present.
validation.scopedCredentialPatternScan: No candidate AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/JWT keys were found in the source text files by the scoped pattern scan. This is not a universal secret or legal review.
validation.browserRetest: Import did not rerun the historical full browser suites. Their actual scope and unverified items are preserved in the retained evidence JSON files.

files.modificationReason: Four original logo PNGs are unavailable. Replaced broken clickable previews with noninteractive filename/unavailable notices, preserved proposal captions, linked available film-logo guides, removed the unused zoom dialog/script. Original review-folder HTML remains unchanged.
